europe_now.title: Russia escalates Ukraine conflict with North Korean missiles and civilian casualties
europe_now.summary: Russia launched missile attacks using North Korean weapons against Ukrainian cities, including Kyiv and Zaporizhzhia. The strikes caused civilian casualties and intensified the ongoing war in Europe.

europe_now.title: Ceuta migration crisis exposes EU-Morocco power imbalance
europe_now.summary: A surge of migrants at the Ceuta border highlighted EU reliance on Morocco for migration control. The crisis revealed structural vulnerabilities in the bloc's external border management strategy.

top_stories.title: Ukraine conflict escalation with Russian missile strikes
top_stories.summary: Russian forces deployed North Korean-made missiles in attacks targeting Ukrainian infrastructure. The assaults resulted in civilian deaths and injuries, deepening the humanitarian crisis in the region.

top_stories.title: EU weakens climate rules amid heatwave, risking economic consequences
top_stories.summary: European Union officials relaxed environmental regulations during record-breaking summer temperatures. A Dutch bank warned these changes could trigger long-term economic instability across member states.

top_stories.title: Hungary elects Orbán critic as president amid political shift
top_stories.summary: The Hungarian parliament selected a former judge previously removed by Viktor Orbán as the nation's new president. This appointment signals a potential recalibration of power within the country's political landscape.

top_stories.title: Baltic region advances defense innovation against Russian threat
top_stories.summary: Startups in Estonia and Latvia are developing rapid-response defense technologies to counter Russian aggression. These initiatives reflect growing regional security concerns along NATO's eastern frontier.

europe_now.summary: Russian missile strikes have hit the Ukrainian cities of Kyiv and Zaporizhzhia, causing civilian casualties and infrastructure damage. The attacks represent a renewed escalation in the broader Russia‑Ukraine conflict that has intensified across August.

europe_now.title: EU establishes communications channel with Meta and TikTok over Ceuta migrant crisis
europe_now.summary: The European Union has established a direct communications channel with Meta and TikTok to address the ongoing migrant influx into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta. The initiative follows criticism that EU policies have granted excessive influence to Morocco in managing border flows.

top_stories.title: A former judge dismissed by Orbán appointed as Hungarian president
top_stories.summary: A former judge who was dismissed by Prime Minister Viktor Orbán has been appointed as Hungary's new president following a parliamentary vote. The appointment reflects ongoing political dynamics within Hungary and signals a shift in the country's leadership.

top_stories.title: France enacts law banning unsolicited telemarketing calls
top_stories.summary: France has implemented a law prohibiting unsolicited telemarketing calls to consumers across the country. The measure aims to protect privacy and reduce disruptive marketing practices.

top_stories.title: Dutch bank warns EU climate rule relaxations could cause economic doom loop
top_stories.summary: A Dutch bank has warned that the European Union's relaxation of climate regulations during a severe heatwave could trigger an economic 'doom loop'. The criticism highlights concerns that weakened environmental standards may exacerbate financial risks amid extreme weather events.
